proposal.hypothesis: Vectorized float4 loads with 16 elements per thread and one reused parameter load set per row chunk increase ILP and bandwidth utilization for the 512x4096 tanh-GELU workload.

Processing 32 float4-vectorized elements per thread with bias values held in registers doubles instruction-level parallelism and halves bias-load and dispatch overhead versus 16 elements per thread, while a 32x8 threadgroup preserves coalesced access across rows.
